encoding_variations: Existence is attested three ways with different vocabularies: a CPA letter (prose attestation + CPA license/state), a business license (issuing authority + license number + dates), or a Secretary-of-State good-standing record (entity number + status). verification_document_type is the required disambiguator — a 'good standing' phrase means different things across the three.
Good-standing status may read 'Active', 'Good Standing', 'Current', or 'In Compliance'; keep the verbatim phrase in the snippet since it degrades to a string.

open_questions.q: CPA license as its own field — cpa_license_number_and_state is folded into the flattened verifying_authority_or_cpa.
open_questions.recommendation: keep folded for now; promote to a typed field if a rule ever verifies the CPA's licensure independently

open_questions.q: percent degradation — ownership_percentage degrades to a string (no percent coercer). A self-employment rule may later need a typed number.
open_questions.recommendation: accept string now; flag for a coercer when such a rule is built

open_questions.q: Three-document conflation — CPA letter, business license, and SOS record are quite different artifacts under one type.
open_questions.recommendation: verification_document_type disambiguates; flag to the domain expert whether they should split

notes: No rules read this document today, so there is no rule floor; this document proves a self-employed borrower's business exists and is active (a CPA letter, a business license, or a Secretary-of-State record).

Prompt hint (doc-level): this is a self-employment support document — the reviewer wants: business exists, is active/current as of a recent date, the borrower's ownership %, and an independent verifier.
Prompt hint (doc-level): do not compute self-employment duration (a derived figure) — capture business_start_date and formation_or_incorporation_date as stated.

PII: ein_or_state_entity_number_masked (pre_masked true) needs _PII_FIELDS registration. The registry's employer_ein is masked; this is analogous but a distinct field name and must be registered. No borrower SSN in this catalog.

Ambiguity: industry_or_business_activity's why is 'processor/identity' (classified processor, first listed); verification_document_type's why is 'identity/disambiguator' (classified identity, first listed).
